Params> void TraceArti (const MsgId &msg_id, const Params &... params) noexcept; Handles a modeled message, specific to the used trace tool. This function is only called internally by the Logger framework when switching between Log and TraceArti. It represents the interface to trace tools. The runtime overhead of this function shall be kept as minimal as possible, e.g. by using specializations based on the MsgId.
